overview.description: The Praxis Impact International ETF (PRXI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed, faith-based portfolio of foreign companies in developed markets outside North America. It selects securities that reflect the foundational core values screened using impact strategies. PRXI was launched on Jun 24, 2026 and is issued by Praxis.

data.title: Praxis Launches PRXI, Its First International ETF For Faith-Based Investors
data.text: GOSHEN, Ind.--(BUSINESS WIRE)---- $PRXI--Praxis Investment Management today launched the Praxis Impact International ETF (PRXI), its first ETF focused on international markets.
